title: ProfileMeasurementsUpdatedV1
description: A person's measurement set changed (`replaceMeasurements`): measurements were set, replaced or removed. Producer `profile`; aggregate `profile` with the profile's `prf_` id; `subjectUserId` is the person's `usr_` id. Names the changed measurements and their units, never a value: measurements are S3 (doc 11 §6) and an outbox payload holds ids and references only (doc 06 §6), so a consumer reads the current set through profile's public API. The full event is the envelope (envelope.json) narrowed by this schema; the payload is open content, so consumers ignore properties they do not know (doc 06 §4), but each change object is closed and holds the unit only.

userId.description: The person whose measurements changed, a prefixed ULID (`usr_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.user`); the API's `UserId`

ProfileMeasurementsUpdatedV1Changes.description: The measurements this write set, replaced or removed, keyed by measurement id (shared-kernel `registry/measurement-definitions.json`, as in the API's `BodyMeasurements`). Each entry names the stored unit and nothing else

ProfileMeasurementsUpdatedV1LengthChange.description: A changed length measurement: its stored unit, never its value. Closed, so no later v1 producer can add a value or any other field (doc 11 §6)

ProfileMeasurementsUpdatedV1MassChange.description: A changed mass measurement: its stored unit, never its value. Closed, so no later v1 producer can add a value or any other field (doc 11 §6)
